gameDescriptionHtml:
Find new ways to cart cargo with FREIGHT HAULER. Marshall freight to its destination free from instructions or schedules. It’s your choices, your strategy, as freight cars populate the route, each one looking for a home. Switch, shunt and haul them all as you see fit.

The forecast calls to you with LIVE WEATHER, have in-game weather powered by real-time location-specific data, getting you deep into the action exactly as it’s happening out in the World. The next job awaits, no matter the meteorology.

Take things a step further with enhanced realism by enabling safety systems by default! Now, should you choose to, step into the cab and find that the likes of AWS, PZB and more are already enabled – which is often the case for taking over trains – or keep things as they are if you prefer a relaxing run or still want to enable them yourself.

Take things beyond Ultra with an all-new “Epic” settings level, taking better advantage of modern hardware by extending draw distances and improving shadow quality. On top of that, Train Sim World 7 now runs on DirectX 12, supports DLSS 4.5 adding DLAA and upscaling, as well as FSR 4 for upscaling and frame generation. Make visuals the best they can be with an all-new Enhanced Lighting option for all TOD4 routes.✅

Right away, driver! On trains which have guards, they can now open and close the doors, increasing realism for driver-guard operations.

FIND YOUR WAY
With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way.

FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys.

CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains – check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations.

CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection.

Included DLCs:

  • Airedale & Wharfedale Network: Leeds & Bradford – Skipton & Ilkley Route Add-On
  • Amtrak’s Acela
  • Antelope Valley Line: Los Angeles – Lancaster Route Add-On
  • Arosalinie: Chur – Arosa Route Add-On
  • Avanti West Coast BR Class 390 Pendolino EMU Add-On
  • Avanti West Coast BR Class 805 Evero BMU Add-On
  • Bahnstrecke Bremen – Oldenburg Route Add-On
  • Bahnstrecke Leipzig – Dresden Route Add-On
  • Bahnstrecke Nurnberg – Wurzburg Route Add-On
  • Bahnstrecke Salzburg – Rosenheim Route Add-On
  • Bakerloo Line Route Add-On
  • Berninalinie: Tirano – Ospizio Bernina Route Add-On
  • Birmingham Cross-City Line: Lichfield – Bromsgrove & Redditch Route Add-On
  • Blackpool Branches: Preston – Blackpool & Ormskirk Route Add-On
  • BNSF GP60M & GP60B Loco Add-On
  • BNSF SD70ACe Add-On
  • BR 194 & E94 Railtour Pack
  • BR Class 20 ‘Chopper’ Loco Add-On
  • BR Class 31 Loco Add-On
  • BR Class 33 Loco Add-On
  • BR Class 52 ‘Western’ Loco Add-On
  • BR Class 86/2 & Mk2F Coaches Loco Add-On
  • BR Class 90 Electric Freight Loco Add-On
